title: Samosa browser game component diagram
description: The browser side of Samosa: the engine plays a reign through io.show(screen); the UI paints each screen on an emulated Spectrum display; the page presents them, logs every key and offers the table.

components.name: Samosa browser game
components.responsibility: Everything that runs in the browser.

components.name: Engine
components.responsibility: One reign as pure rules and an async flow over an IO interface; no DOM, no timers.

components.name: UI
components.responsibility: One painter per screen, the drawing vocabulary, every string, the art and the sound motifs.

components.name: Platform layer
components.responsibility: The emulated Spectrum display, font, keyboard and touch input, and beeper sound.

components.name: Page (main.ts)
components.responsibility: The title, how to play, About and the sound toggle; presents each engine screen, logs every key and offers the table.

components.name: High-score client (scores.ts)
components.responsibility: Seeds (reigns), submitting the key log, the table and the session name.

components.name: Name rules (name.ts)
components.responsibility: Cleans names for the table, the same as Rally's rules.

components.name: High-score Worker
components.responsibility: The server side of the table.

components.name: Games hub
components.responsibility: The games hub at games.icelander.net (the recreations repository's Worker): sign-in, /me, the multiplayer lobby and one WebSocket relay per online match.
